_meta.note: The _session/steering run of the Real Adapter Contract lane, captured with the lane's own driver (_TURN_DRIVER in test/test_codex_session_mcp.py, run unmodified; its frames_a list is this file). Read in order: the initialize response, whose top-level _meta.steering.supported is true (the advertisement steering_advertised() reads); session/new; the first prompt (id 3) going active while the stub holds its model request open; the answer to the _session/steering request (id 4) sent mid-turn, outcome injected, arriving before the turn ends; then the turn finishing with stopReason end_turn. The stub logged the steered text in the turn's next model request, which test_real_codex_acp_steer_is_injected_into_the_running_turn asserts; requests are not frames, so that half is in the test, not here. Frames after the first prompt's result (close, load and the second adapter run with the idle startedNewTurn steer) are omitted. The adapter is the Real Adapter Contract lane's pinned build (test/real_adapters/package.json, npm ci): codex-acp 2.2.2 bundling @openai/codex 0.160.1, driven over stdio against a loopback Responses-API model stub, so no real model or credential was involved. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, with these reductions at capture: the session uuid is codex-session-1 and the scratch working directory reads ~/work; the available_commands_update frame (the adapter's command inventory) is dropped; models.availableModels is emptied and each multi-option select in configOptions keeps only its current value, as scripts/capture_acp_compaction.py prunes them.
